name: Plan access token (REST API)
description: A token generated by an organization administrator, tied to an Organization or Enterprise plan rather than a user, used for REST API automation and sent in the X-Figma-Token header.

blockers.summary: Figma states no prefix, alphabet or length for a plan access token; the npm registry category's carrier is not described.
The token's string form would need a token generated in a Figma organization, which is not done here.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
